name: Search/Popover
description:
**Overview:** A search field that opens an inline results popover as the user types, enabling instant autocomplete or suggestion-based lookup.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use for command palettes, user @mention inputs, or inline autocomplete search (e.g., "Assign to...").
- ✅ Use when results should appear immediately without a full page navigation.
- ❌ DO NOT use when the result set requires a full results page — use Search/Default with a dedicated results view.

**Props / Variants:** State, Results List, Empty State, Loading State.

**Original Notes:** Autocomplete search with inline results popover.

name: Divider
description:
**Overview:** A thin horizontal or vertical line used to visually separate sections, groups, or items in a layout.

**Use Cases:**
- ✅ Use between sections in a list, sidebar, form, or settings panel.
- ✅ Use with an optional label or icon to create a labeled section break (e.g., "or" in auth forms).
- ❌ DO NOT overuse — rely on whitespace and spacing to separate content when possible.
- ❌ DO NOT use as a structural border for cards or containers — use Frame stroke properties instead.

**Props / Variants:** Orientation (Horizontal/Vertical), Label, Thickness, Inset.

**Original Notes:** Subtle visual separator for structuring content sections.
